Class StaticCompilationReport

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.python.processing.staticcompile.StaticCompilationReport
public final class StaticCompilationReport extends Object
Writes the decisions of a compilation as decisions.jsonl (one JSON object per line, the first one describing the plan, the input of the page a build tool renders) and summary.txt (the decisions grouped by outcome with totals per outcome and per reason), every reason carrying a hint of what to change, and keeps them as decisions.properties, the state an incremental build reads back to complete its own decisions with those of the sources it did not plan.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher

  • Method Details

    • write

      public static List<StaticCompilationDecision> write(Path directory, StaticCompilationMode mode, List<StaticCompilationDecision> decisions, @Nullable Set<String> plannedSources)
      Writes the report. An incremental build plans the affected sources only: the decisions of the previous report for every other source are kept, so both files stay complete, and the plan record says the build was incremental. A planned source without decisions (its functions were removed) loses its previous ones.
      Parameters:
      directory - The directory, created when missing
      mode - The mode of the compilation
      decisions - The decisions of this build
      plannedSources - The paths of the sources this build planned, or null when it planned all of them
      Returns:
      Every decision the report now holds: the retained ones, then this build's

    • write

      public static List<StaticCompilationDecision> write(Path directory, StaticCompilationMode mode, List<StaticCompilationDecision> decisions, @Nullable Set<String> plannedSources, boolean incremental)
      Writes the report, keeping the decisions of the previous report for every source not in plannedSources, see write(Path, StaticCompilationMode, List, Set). The planned sources and the sources of the retained decisions are compared as paths, whatever their form: relative or absolute, through a symbolic link or not.
      Parameters:
      directory - The directory, created when missing
      mode - The mode of the compilation
      decisions - The decisions of this build
      plannedSources - The paths of the sources this write replaces the decisions of, or null to replace them all
      incremental - Whether the build planned the affected sources only, which the plan record says
      Returns:
      Every decision the report now holds: the retained ones, then this build's
      Throws:
      UncheckedIOException - When the directory or a file of the report cannot be written
      Since:
      5.3.0
